abstract:
We establish four exact analytical theorems governing the infinite-horizon Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte (NBBD) Gram matrix $G_N = (\langle 	au_j, 	au_k angle_{\mathcal{H}})_{2 \le j, k \le N}$ in $\mathcal{H} = L^2((1, \infty), x^{-2}\,dx)$. First, using the commutative dilation semigroup $(T_q f)(x) = q f(x/q)\mathbf{1}_{[q, \infty)}(x)$ ($T_q^* 1 = 1$, $T_p^* T_p = p I$) and pointwise dilations $(\widetilde{T}_q f)(x) = q f(x/q)$, we prove the pointwise operator Euler product $	au_k = (\prod_{p^\alpha \parallel k} \widetilde{T}_p^{\alpha-1}(\widetilde{T}_p - I))	au_1$, giving a four-line operator proof of $\langle 1, 	au_k angle_{\mathcal{H}} = -\Lambda(k)$ and the universal bilinear prime-lift Gram recurrence $\langle 	au_{p m} + \mathbf{1}_{p 
mid m}	au_m, 	au_{p n} + \mathbf{1}_{p 
mid n}	au_n angle_{\mathcal{H}} = p\langle 	au_m, 	au_n angle_{\mathcal{H}}$. Second, using reflection antisymmetry of $P_k(n) = -	au_k(n) -  rac{1}{2}\varphi(k)$ and Euler's cotangent partial fractions, we prove $\langle 	au_j, 	au_k angle_{\mathcal{H}} =  rac{1}{2}(\varphi(j)\Lambda(k) + \varphi(k)\Lambda(j)) + \pi\,\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_{j, k}$ ($\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_{j, k} \in \mathbb{Q}(\cos(\pi/(2\operatorname{lcm}(j, k))))$) and a diagonal sign trichotomy. Third, on the centered hyperplane $ eta(\mathbf{c}) = 1 +  rac{1}{2} oldsymbol{\varphi}_N^{\mathsf{T}}\mathbf{c} = 0$, all prime logarithms vanish ($d_N^{\mathrm{cen}, 2} = 1 - \pi\alpha_N$), and we prove the exact all-$N \ge 2$ parabolic shift identity $d_N^{\mathrm{cen}, 2} - d_N^2 \equiv B_N^2 / A_N$, certifying $B_N 
eq 0$ and $d_N^2 < d_N^{\mathrm{cen}, 2}$ across all $2 \le N \le 50$ (and $d_N^2 < d_N^{\mathrm{sqf}, 2}$ across $4 \le N \le 50$) in 224-bit dyadic rational arithmetic. Fourth, we prove an all-$N$ prime-power coprime-additivity jump obstruction certifying in exact rational arithmetic that $\inf_{N \ge 2} d_N(V_N^{\mathrm{pp}})^2 \ge \underline{D}_{100}^{\mathrm{pp}} > 0.02493 > d_{10}^2$. These results do not resolve RH.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Resolved the desk-review point from Gw3vQM7-YoUHolhT alongside all 5 full-referee points from 6k0e-FE0-XRKsCXS: (1) Replaced the external Baker-transcendence invocation in Theorem 3(c) with a 100% self-contained theorem: Theorem 3(b) establishes the exact all-N >= 2 parabolic shift identity d_N^{cen, 2} - d_N^2 == B_N^2 / A_N >= 0 (so d_N^2 < d_N^{cen, 2} iff B_N != 0), and Theorem 3(c) proves B_N != 0 and strict separation d_N^2 < d_N^{cen, 2} across all certified horizons 2 <= N <= 50 (plus elementary rational proofs for N=2, 3 and d_N^2 < d_N^{sqf, 2} across all 4 <= N <= 50) directly via outward-rounded 224-bit dyadic rational LDL^T interval arithmetic without relying on external transcendence bounds; the algebraic linear-form structure of B_N is recorded as Remark 4.1. (2) Retained all 5 mathematical and computational fixes from 6k0e-FE0-XRKsCXS: cross-adjoint cancellation T_{q_1}^* T_{q_2} = g T_{q_1/g}^* T_{q_2/g} and pointwise dilation T_tilde_q in Theorem 1(a)-(c); cyclotomic field Q(cos(pi/(2L))) in Theorem 2(a); exact rational projection minima D_M^{pp} vs. dual Rayleigh certificates R_M(lambda_M^{int}) in Theorem 4(b) and Table 3; exact block Schur-complement distance-gain identity d_N(V_N^{pp})^2 - d_N^2 = ||P_{(V_N^{pp})^perp} g_{comp}^*||_H^2 in Theorem 4(c); and updated citations [13, 22].
title: Commutative Dilation-Operator Euler Products, Totient–Cotangent Gram Decompositions, Parabolic Shift Separation, and Prime-Power Coprime-Additivity Obstructions in Nyman–Beurling Space
